description: Ace to Five of Cups in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for each card, how they form an emotional story, and how to use them in a tarot spread.
lede: The Ace to Five of Cups follow feelings from an opening of the heart to loss and reappraisal. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, in order: Ace of Cups, Two of Cups, Three of Cups, Four of Cups and Five of Cups. Each shows its number and a cup icon with the card name beneath. No scenes are drawn.
faces.caption: Ace to Five of Cups in order, shown as simple number-and-suit card faces.
